_comment: FORMAT EXAMPLE. Invented values. Copy to seed/ (gitignored) and replace with the real configuration. Never commit seed/.
_rules: Weights for a year must sum to 100 across kind='area'. The loader rejects anything else.
Lanes (kind='run' and kind='signals') carry no percentage. Run is capped in hours per week.
Weights are fixed for a whole year and re-decided at the yearly review (ADR-0007). The loader will not overwrite an existing year without an explicit flag.
A year with no weights triggers the year gate: balance factors go stale and the Year Review unlocks.
